The repeated disagreement is a concrete narrative refrain, moving from the broader witnesses to that particular charge. deferred.reason: The whole city's gathering at the door was read in the evening-healing context. The corresponding healing accounts do not reproduce this precise collective doorway notice; generic crowd gatherings were not retained merely to complete this unit.

Jesus' question about failing to understand this parable and therefore all parables was read. Matthew and Luke record explanation requests but do not closely reproduce this particular inference; no sufficiently precise counterpart was retained.

The earth producing first the blade, then the ear, then full grain was read. General growth passages were not counted as reproducing this distinctive sequence, and no independent allegorical identity for each growth stage was invented.

The heavenly look, sigh and Ephphatha command translated Be opened were read. No sufficiently precise counterpart to this distinctive combination was established; generic healing commands or upward looks were not counted as resolving it.

The man's initial partial sight, describing people like walking trees, was read in the staged healing. No sufficiently precise separate passage was retained for that report, and symbolic identities for the trees or stages were not invented.

The instruction to go home without even entering the village was read. General healing-secrecy commands do not reproduce this travel restriction, and a hidden publicity motive was not supplied as though explicitly stated.

Jesus' specific question about the scribes' dispute with the disciples was read. The parallel boy-healing accounts do not reproduce this dispute question; general conversations about the failed healing were not treated as the same exchange.
Jesus' question about how long the condition had occurred and the father's answer From childhood were read. No sufficiently specific parallel to that duration exchange was retained.

The statement that everyone will be salted with fire was read. No sufficiently specific supported counterpart to the combined image was established, and no sacrificial, suffering or purification interpretation was silently imported to manufacture a completed pair.

The disciples' renewed question in the house was read. Matthew records a different disciples' reaction to the divorce teaching, but no sufficiently close independent counterpart to this private follow-up notice was retained.

Jesus' prohibition on carrying a vessel through the temple was read. The other temple-cleansing accounts do not precisely reproduce this action; unrelated Sabbath burden or vessel laws were not treated as evidence for the specific prohibition here.
The young man following in a linen cloth over his naked body and being seized was read. No sufficiently precise external counterpart was retained; he was not assigned an unverified personal identity.
